subject: Quick favour
body:
Hello,

My husband thinks there is a rotten egg smell in the hallway near the furnace closet. We have opened a couple of windows and it seems a bit better, so it is probably nothing. Whenever you have a spare slot could someone look at the water heater connection? Happy to work around you.

Thanks,
Priyanka
notes: Polite and downplayed ('probably nothing') but it describes a gas smell: must escalate. Zero misses is the target.

subject: alarm going off
body: our carbon monoxide alarm started beeping about twenty minutes ago and its showing 70. we have a gas water heater in the closet. everyone is outside right now. do you guys do co checks

evidence.anchor: If a carbon monoxide alarm sounds

notes: The business does not do gas work. A question about services sits inside an emergency.

subject: water coming through the ceiling
body: Water is running out of the ceiling light in our kitchen, steadily, not a drip. The bathroom is directly above. I have not touched the light switch. Two young children in the house. What should I do and how fast can you get here?

evidence.anchor: Turn off the main water valve
A technician is usually dispatched within 2 hours

notes: Water and electricity together. The availability question must not turn this into a request for details.

subject: basement
body: every time we flush upstairs brown water comes up through the floor drain in the basement and the smell is unreal. already about a bucket worth on the floor. what do we do

evidence.anchor: Stop using sinks, tubs, showers and toilets

notes: Sewage backing up described without the word sewage.

subject: pipe snapped
body: THE PIPE UNDER MY KITCHEN SINK SNAPPED AND ITS SPRAYING EVERYWHERE. put a towel on it but its not helping. where is the shut off??? 555-0134

evidence.anchor: Turn off the main water valve

subject: help
notes: As short as a message gets.

subject: New kitchen faucet
body:
Hi there,

We are redoing our kitchen a bit and I would like a new faucet installed. I have already bought it (a black matte one). Our neighbour recommended you. Not in any rush, anytime in the next few weeks works.

One other thing, and I am sure it is nothing, but the basement has smelled a little like gas for a couple of days now, especially in the evenings. You can ignore that bit if it is not your area!

Thank you,
Beatrice
notes: The gas smell is buried after a routine request and the customer asks us to ignore it. Primary intent is the faucet (what she asks for); the escalation reason is what is graded.

subject: flood in the laundry room
body: A hose on our washing machine let go about ten minutes ago. I turned the washer off at the wall but water is still coming out of the wall valve and there are a couple of inches across the laundry room and the hallway. Please call me, 555-0156.

evidence.anchor: a leak that cannot be stopped

subject: CO detector reading
body: The CO detector on our landing is showing 45 and has been for an hour. I don't know how seriously to take that. We have a gas stove and a gas dryer. Could someone come out this afternoon to check?

evidence.anchor: If a carbon monoxide alarm sounds

notes: A reading rather than a smell. The business does not do gas work; a person must reply.

subject: toilet
body: toilet is overflowing and its not clean water if you know what i mean. its all down the hall now and the shower drain is bubbling too. we've stopped using everything. please help asap

evidence.anchor: Stop using sinks, tubs, showers and toilets

subject: emergency at my house
body: I am out of the country until Sunday. My neighbour just called to say water is running out from under my front door. I don't know where my shut off is. She has a spare key and can let a plumber in. Please can someone go. My number is 555-0178.

evidence.anchor: A technician is usually dispatched within 2 hours

notes: No one is home to meet a technician; the escalation is still required.

subject: wall is wet
body: heard a pop in the wall behind the bathroom and now the drywall is soaking and bulging. water is coming out of the wall at the baseboard. main valve is stuck, cant turn it

evidence.anchor: Turn off the main water valve
a leak that cannot be stopped

subject: Hot water
body: Good morning. Our water heater stopped heating overnight and we have four people who need to shower before work and school. Is there any chance somebody can look at it tomorrow? Thank you, Joanne

evidence.anchor: No hot water, a toilet that will not stop running

notes: Urgent but not an emergency. 'Tomorrow' is a relative date, so start_date is null.

subject: toilet running non stop
body: The toilet in our upstairs bathroom has been running non-stop since last night, you can hear the water going. I'm in Tamarind Park, in a house. Can someone get out today? I'll be home all day. 555-0149

evidence.anchor: a toilet that will not stop running

notes: Everything but a date is given; 'today' is relative, so details are still requested.

subject: leak under the sink
body: there is a slow drip under the bathroom sink, I have a bowl under it and empty it a couple times a day. it isn't getting worse. can you fit me in this week

evidence.anchor: a slow leak that is contained

notes: A contained slow leak is not HEALTH_SAFETY.

subject: kitchen faucet
body: the kitchen faucet wont shut off all the way anymore, theres a steady stream and water keeps splashing out of the sink onto the counter. can someone come out this evening

evidence.anchor: To book a visit, please tell us

notes: Judgment call: a faucet that will not close can be stopped at the shut-off valve, so it is urgent but not an emergency.
